result:
All 14 queries ran against their input files and gave plausible answers. I checked the results by eye, mostly against the first few lines of each file, and I didn't check them against a reference.

- **Likely traps:** For J3, package names with an `@scope/` prefix could break the keyword-to-string step. None of the names in this file have one.
- **J11/J12/J13:** Their answers print with `:keyword` keys rather than quoted strings. I took that to be how qlang writes map keys.
- **J9:** I only skimmed the server file for `db` roles, so that `true` is the least checked.

H1: /data | filter ~(/active | eq true) | filter ~(coalesce ~(/address/city) ~(null) | type | eq ::string) | sort ~(/name | lower) * /name
H2: filter ~(coalesce ~(/status | lower) ~("") | eq "paid") * (coalesce ~(/items) ~([]) * mul /qty /price) | flat | sum | round 2
H3: :r / | /dependencies | union (r | /devDependencies) | filter ~(startsWith "^") | :m / | keys * (:k / | print | drop 1 | append "@" | append (m | at k))
H4: filter ~(/state | eq "open") * (coalesce ~(/assignee/login) ~("unassigned")) | groupBy ~(/) * count
H5: :d / | /services | filter ~(coalesce ~(/enabled) ~(true) | ne false) | sort ~(/name) * {:name /name :timeout (coalesce ~(/timeout) ~(d | /defaults/timeout)) :retries (coalesce ~(/retries) ~(d | /defaults/retries))}
H6: filter ~(coalesce ~(/durationMs) ~(null) | type | eq ::number) | groupBy ~(/service) * (* /durationMs | :v / | sum | div (v | count) | round 1)
H7: filter ~(coalesce ~(/stock) ~(null) | type | eq ::number) | filter ~(/stock | gt 0) | sort ~(/price) | reverse | take 3 * /name
H8: groupBy ~(/dept) * (* (coalesce ~(/skills) ~([])) | flat | * lower | distinct | sort)
H9: filter ~(coalesce ~(/role | lower) ~("") | eq "db") | every ~(if (/region | eq "eu-west") ~(coalesce ~(/cpu/cores) ~(0) | gte 8) ~(false))
H10: "Alice@Example.com, bob@test.org; carol@EXAMPLE.com, dave@mail.net; erin@Test.org, frank@example.com" | split ";" * split "," | flat * (split "@" | /1 | lower) | distinct | sort
H11: lines * split " " * {:path /2 :st (/3 | parseJson)} | filter ~(/st | gte 500) | :rs / * /path | distinct * (:p / | {:path p :count (rs * /path | filter ~(eq p) | count)}) | sort ~([(/count | mul -1) /path]) | take 2
H12: lines | drop 1 * split "," | filter ~(/2 | count | gt 0) * {:team /1 :score (/2 | parseJson)} | groupBy ~(/team) * (* /score | :v / | sum | div (v | count) | round 2)
H13: lines | filter ~(contains "==") | filter ~(startsWith "#" | eq false) * (split "==" | {:name (/0 | lower) :version /1}) | indexBy ~(/name) * /version
H14: sort ~(coalesce ~(/comments) ~([]) * (coalesce ~(/likes) ~(0)) | sum) | last | /title
